<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs`; edit the source it names instead. -->

Let cuilo run this project's own formatters and linters, such as Biome, on generated files.

## Usage

```sh
cuilo trust [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--revoke` | Stop running them. |

## Global options

`--root`, `--json` and `--no-input` work here too; see [global options](/reference/cli/#global-options).
